body:
**Backfill, 2026-11-11** (written after the fact; times are approximate, US Eastern). From here on each entry is written as it happens.

- **#527 adopted** (morning). Created the Stage, Owner and Kind org fields, the "Next release" milestones and `needs:` labels in both repos; this repo created at James's word (#542, closed).
- **James's UI pass filed** under north-foster-farm#526: features #530, #535, #538 and their work issues. Landed on `next` and staging: #541 (North Scituate), #536 (How to buy), #537 (news excerpt), #531 (cart icons), #532 (discount code), #533 (smooth Hide), #534 (card wording), #561 (section bar), #560 (trash icon, Clear cart badge). The picker design #539 approved by James; its build #540 landed and is on staging for his sign-off, no e2e until then.
- **Pawtucket** filed as #543 with #544 to #548; #544 landed and staging's schedule carries its lines; #545 (post) landed as a draft; #547 (Instagram) drafted; James's calls are listed on #548.
- **VFF hotfix #550**: built from `main`, checks run through PR #555, pushed to `main` by the coordinator at James's word; production `0acfe070`. Production's pickup schedule extended through 12-31 by James.
- **Christmas week**: #553 (moving a delivery day) deferred by James; #554 (no delivery 12-24) landed on `next` and staging.
- **e2e outage** (GitHub's runners couldn't reach Ubuntu mirrors): runs cancelled, #556 filed, the Playwright container built and reviewed; waiting on James's approval of the image. The flaky landing test filed as #557. #549 (keyboard bug, live since before today) fixed on a branch; its specs wait on #556.
- **Review-run overwrite** found on #533 (a review run pushed over a lane's work): restored, rule written in the coordinator's brief, fix filed as #552 and built into the dashboard's workflow (PR #86).
- **Dashboard parity** (James's step 1): the audit (#45) filed as 37 issues under nff-dashboard#43; PRs #30, #36, #7, #41, #42, #26, #18, #88, #89, #90, #91, #92 brought to review or ready; step 2 filed as nff-dashboard#87. One private item, details with James.
- **This repo**: PRs #2, #3, #11, #13, #16 built and reviewed, waiting on James's merges.
- **GitHub Actions outage** (evening): ghost runs on `next`; CodeQL run through draft PR #563, staging moved to `2c30be87`.
- **Sweep** (James's #527 request): decisions written into their issues; summary on north-foster-farm#527 (comment 6802590087).
- **Found by hand**: site code-scanning alert #15, open since 2026-10-18 with no issue, now north-foster-farm#564 (built, in security review). The poll's blind spots are #17 (James: watch the whole org), in progress.

**2026-11-11 18:45 ET.** James asked that every coordinator poll that finds something, and every action, be written to GitHub. Done: this log (#18, pinned), backfilled above; the rule written into the coordinator's brief, the bullpen skill, the poll prompt (the poll's cron now names this log) and memory; a helper and the public copy of the rule queued with the workflow lane after #17 (the org-wide poll). Open now: site #564 (stack-trace alert) in security review; #17 building.

**2026-11-11 ~19:00 ET, poll.** Found: James approved the Playwright container image on north-foster-farm#556 (by voice); security approved north-foster-farm#564. Did: landed #564 on next (84b3c4f0); rebased and landed #556's CI change on next (7cb8e48a), so e2e runs in the pinned container; rebased #549 (keyboard fix) onto next and started its specs, the container's first real use (run 43122543576). Next: land #549 if its specs pass; move staging once next's checks pass. Notes posted on #556 and #564.
